# Fixtures

Tests contain no Cyrillic: Russian test data lives here and in `tests/cases/*.json`, loaded through `fixture_text`, `fixture_bytes`, `cases` and `case` from `tests/conftest.py`.

- `encodings-source.txt`: UTF-8 source lines (title, prose sentence, capitals heading, short word) shared by tests and the generator; `alphabet.txt`: letters for Hypothesis strategies.
- `export-desc.xml`: shared `<description>` fragment for `tests/test_export.py`.
- Cases: `tests/cases/export.json` (block table plus per-test data), `export_synthetic_ids.json`, `metadata.json`, `docs_examples.json`.

Encoding fixtures are generated by `python tests/fixtures/make_encodings.py` from `encodings-source.txt`; every one holds the title and the prose sentence.

- `utf8-bom.fb2`: UTF-8 with BOM and a `utf-8` prolog.
- `cp1251-no-prolog.fb2`: encoded `cp1251`, no prolog.
- `koi8r-no-prolog.fb2`: encoded `koi8-r`, no prolog.
- `koi8r-prolog.fb2`: encoded `koi8-r`, prolog says `koi8-r`.
- `wrong-prolog-cp1251.fb2`: prolog says `utf-8`, bytes are `cp1251`.
- `binary-cover.fb2`: real 1x1 PNG in three `binary` elements, base64 wrapped at 20 chars; regenerate with `python tests/fixtures/make_binary_cover.py`.
- `utf16-doctype.fb2`: `xxe-doctype.fb2` re-encoded as UTF-16 with BOM: `iconv -f utf-8 -t utf-16 tests/fixtures/xxe-doctype.fb2 > tests/fixtures/utf16-doctype.fb2`.
- `regression-nul-in-prolog.fb2`: `minimal.fb2` with a NUL byte inside the prolog encoding name (found by fuzz; used to raise `ValueError`).
- `minimal.fb2`, `bare-amp.fb2`, `control-chars.fb2`, `unclosed-tag.fb2`, `metadata-full.fb2`, `structure-rich.fb2`, `notes-and-links.fb2`: hand-written XML, edited directly (no generator): minimal valid book, unescaped `&`, control characters, EOF-truncated document, full metadata, rich section structure, notes and links.
- `entity-bomb.fb2`, `xxe-doctype.fb2`: hand-written `<!ENTITY>`/`<!DOCTYPE>` inputs that must raise `Fb2UnsafeInputError`.
- `sample.fb2`: hand-written showcase book for docs and `examples/` (metadata, cover, nested sections, poem, table, cite, two notes, inline image); `tests/test_docs_examples.py` pins its output.
- `container.fbz`: zip holding one `book.fb2` entry (a minimal book).
- Real-book corpus: not in git; run `FB2KIT_CORPUS=<dir> uv run pytest -m corpus -s`.
